mappings.shopifySource: Versioned Admin GraphQL endpoint; the authorized connector reported Admin API 2026-10 during validation
mappings.transformation: Record the exact endpoint or connector-reported API version without substitution
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Block collection provenance rather than infer a version

mappings.shopifySource: QueryRoot.deliveryProfiles -> DeliveryProfile id, name, default, coversAllItems
mappings.transformation: Replace GIDs with deterministic references; retain configuration flags
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Set profiles completeness to inaccessible or partial

mappings.shopifySource: DeliveryProfile.profileItems -> DeliveryProfileItem.product and variants
mappings.transformation: Map every assigned Variant to its sanitized Variant reference
mappings.pagination: Exhaust profileItems and nested variants; any nested next page makes the dataset partial
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Do not infer an assignment; mark profiles partial

mappings.shopifySource: No single DeliveryProfile field proves quotation-only checkout enforcement
mappings.transformation: Set unverified unless separately supported enforcement evidence exists
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use unverified; never infer quotation enforcement

mappings.shopifySource: DeliveryProfileLocationGroup.locationGroupZones -> DeliveryZone.countries and provinces
mappings.transformation: Normalize countryCode and province code; preserve rest-of-world as unresolved rather than a country
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Set zones completeness to partial or inaccessible

mappings.shopifySource: DeliveryLocationGroupZone.methodDefinitions -> active, methodConditions, rateProvider
mappings.transformation: Fixed prices become cents; a zero fixed price is verified zero; carrier participants remain unverified because the final checkout price is dynamic
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Keep amount null and effectivePriceStatus unverified

mappings.shopifySource: No Shopify shipping-rate field represents Rhino operations approval
mappings.transformation: Set missing until an accepted K-EVID receipt is attached
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use missing

mappings.shopifySource: QueryRoot.discountNodes -> Discount union type, status, classes, appDiscountType
mappings.transformation: Free-shipping union types map to zero_shipping; active shipping-class app discounts map to unverified unless their complete price effect is proven
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Set discounts completeness to inaccessible; never treat missing data as no discounts

mappings.shopifySource: Discount union typename, Discount.discountClasses, and AppDiscountType.discountClasses
mappings.transformation: Explicit free shipping is zero_shipping; shipping Functions and reduced-shipping effects remain unverified without effective-price proof
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use unverified for any active unknown shipping effect

mappings.shopifySource: QueryRoot.markets -> Market.status, Market.conditions.regionsCondition, Market.delivery.shipping
mappings.transformation: Normalize country and subdivision regions and active state
mappings.pagination: Exhaust markets and nested regions connections
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Set markets completeness to partial or inaccessible

mappings.shopifySource: Market ACTIVE status and regions do not independently prove a successful checkout path
mappings.transformation: Use unverified unless a separately authorized checkout assessment confirms or disproves availability
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use unverified

mappings.shopifySource: QueryRoot.locations -> Location.isActive and Location.localPickupSettingsV2
mappings.transformation: A non-null localPickupSettingsV2 establishes configured pickup at that location only
mappings.pagination: Exhaust locations.pageInfo with inactive and legacy locations included
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Set pickup completeness to inaccessible

mappings.transformation: Set missing until K-EVID-001 provides accepted explicit eligibility
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use missing

mappings.pagination: Exhaust inventory pages when item-level readiness is assessed
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use missing

mappings.shopifySource: ProductVariant.inventoryItem.requiresShipping
mappings.transformation: Copy the boolean for every paginated Variant
mappings.unavailableBehavior: Set products completeness to partial

mappings.shopifySource: ProductVariant.inventoryItem.measurement.weight

mappings.unavailableBehavior: Use null or missing evidence status; never infer packed weight
